source.citation: Pesaresi M., Politis P. (2023), GHS-BUILT-S R2023A, European Commission Joint Research Centre
source.definition: Binary cell selection: 2020 building-covered surface >= 50000 square metres per 1000000-square-metre cell. Residential and non-residential buildings included. No smoothing or invented expansion.
source.limitations: Generalized satellite-derived reference, not a legal urban boundary or individual building footprints. Small/sparse settlements may not meet the threshold. 2020 values are modelled from the multitemporal GHSL series.

note.en: Built-up reference: GHSL 2020, 1 km cells with at least 5% building coverage. This generalized satellite-derived extent is not a planning or administrative boundary; small or sparse settlements may be absent.
note.zh-CN: 建成区参考：GHSL 2020，1 公里网格内建筑覆盖率至少 5%。这是遥感数据概化范围，不是规划或行政边界；小型、稀疏聚落可能未显示。
note.zh-TW: 建成區參考：GHSL 2020，1 公里網格內建築覆蓋率至少 5%。這是遙感資料概化範圍，不是規劃或行政邊界；小型、稀疏聚落可能未顯示。
